datasets.name: Sentinel-2 MSI imagery
datasets.verbatim: To carry out this research, multispectral images acquired by the MSI (MultiSpectral Instrument) sensor on board the Sentinel- 2B satellite were utilized.

methods.name: Floating References (FR) and Homogeneous Blocks Single-class Classification (HBSC)
methods.summary: The FR method uses floating references identified through clustering to model spatio-temporal changes based on behavioral deviations. The HBSC method identifies homogeneous blocks as 'no change' regions and uses a One-class Support Vector Machine to extrapolate and detect changes across the spatial domain.
methods.source: Negri and Frery (2019); Negri et al. (2021)
